name: Cistella (Spain)
description: Dark blue field charged at the centre with the yellow basket of the arms.
history: The council opened the adoption file on 23 February 2015 and the flag was approved on 28 November 2016 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya; it is based on the arms, an oblong flag of 2:3, dark blue, with the yellow basket of the arms half the height at the centre.

features.role: basket (cistella), the canting figure, half the height
